prompt.en: A hands-free station does not key from room noise, but the first syllable of each reply is missing before transmit starts. Which control area is the best first check?

text.en: VOX sensitivity and timing for earlier voice-operated switching
Lower VOX sensitivity so only louder speech can key the transmitter
Lengthening only the VOX release delay after speech stops
Maximum speech processing to raise average SSB power

explanation.en: Clipped first syllables point to VOX start sensitivity or timing; release delay and speech processing do not make transmit start sooner.

prompt.en: An emergency packet link must either deliver a shelter supply list correctly or report that it failed. Which feature provides that reliability?

text.en: Automatic repeat requests for damaged or missing frames
Turning off acknowledgements so messages move faster
Adding speech compression to the packet audio
Forwarding every packet to an internet gateway

explanation.en: ARQ-style repeat requests let a packet system correct bad frames or report failure instead of silently losing the message.

prompt.en: On a busy digital HF segment, many FT8 traces fit inside the space one SSB voice signal would use. What property makes that possible?

text.en: Each FT8 signal occupies a very narrow bandwidth
Every FT8 station transmits on exactly the same audio tone
FT8 uses the same 2 kHz to 3 kHz audio width as SSB voice
Receiver DSP removes all overlap between wide digital signals

explanation.en: FT8 contacts can be packed closely because each individual signal is narrow; they are not full-width SSB voice signals.
